title: Otter & Fox - The River Crossing
objective: Restore the cable ferry and get both animals safely to the riverside shelter.

body.description: An animal able to move and handle small objects.

agents.role: An otter who swims and anchors lines, but cannot rig ropes or repair machinery. Coordinate with the fox and carry prepared supplies across the water.

body.description: A swimming otter with nimble paws and space for one small item. Heavy toolboxes are too large.

agents.role: A fox skilled in rope rigging and machinery repair, but unable to swim. Share prepared rope with the otter and build a safe crossing.

body.description: A land-bound fox able to carry two inventory units and operate animal-adapted tools with its mouth, but unable to swim.

near-bank.name: Near riverbank
near-bank.description: A fast river separates you from safety. A rigging bench, loose rope, heavy toolbox and broken ferry winch stand here. Swimming requires the swim ability; a repaired ferry carries non-swimmers.

far-bank.name: Far riverbank
far-bank.description: A solid mooring post stands above the current. A marked path leads to the riverside shelter, but the crossing must be restored before the team leaves.

shelter.name: Riverside shelter
shelter.description: A dry shelter above the river. Both partners must arrive after restoring the ferry.

river.name: Fast river channel
river.description: A deep channel that only a swimmer can cross. Loose flight or movement commands cannot create another route.

ferry.name: Cable ferry crossing
ferry.description: A safe crossing for both animals once a line is anchored and the winch repaired.

shelter-path.name: Shelter path
shelter-path.description: The final trail. Finish restoring the ferry before leaving the river behind.

bench.name: Rigging bench
bench.description: A guide explains that a rigger must prepare the loose rope before a swimmer can secure it to the far post. Oversized bite loops, beak tabs and broad paw controls make this fixture animal-adapted.

rope.name: Loose ferry rope
rope.description: A light rope. It must be prepared by a rigger, passed to a swimmer, and permanently anchored on the far bank. Large bite loops and paw guides let animals prepare and secure the line.

toolbox.name: Heavy repair toolbox
toolbox.description: Two inventory units of winch repair tools. Animal-adapted repair jigs and bite-operated tools sit in a mouth-carried harness.

winch.name: Ferry winch
winch.description: A mechanical winch on the near bank. A repairer needs the heavy toolbox and a secured far-bank line. Oversized bite loops, beak tabs and broad paw controls make this fixture animal-adapted.

mooring.name: Far-bank mooring post
mooring.description: A swimmer can install a properly prepared rope here. Installed ropes cannot be picked up again. Oversized bite loops, beak tabs and broad paw controls make this fixture animal-adapted.

skill_challenges.description: Rig the carried rope into a safe ferry line at the bench.
Anchor the prepared rope permanently to the far-bank post.
Repair and tension the ferry winch using the heavy toolbox and anchored line.
